items.source: /// The one-line summary; every count names what it counts.

items.name: summary
items.source:
fn summary(
    parity: bool,
    failed: bool,
    skipped: usize,
    areas_not_run: &[Value],
    targets_not_run: &[String],
    output: &Path,
) -> String {
    let area_names: Vec<String> = areas_not_run
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|area| area["name"].as_str().map(str::to_string))
        .collect();
    format!(
        "verification parity={parity} failed={failed} skipped={skipped} areas_not_run={}{} targets_not_run={}{} result={}",
        area_names.len(),
        named(&area_names),
        targets_not_run.len(),
        named(targets_not_run),
        output.display()
    )
}
